  B)      Apply Model view controller architecture pattern in case of designing employee time

  a logistics management application.                                                    (5)

  scenario with YouTube manager to introduce lazy initialization and caching to a third    (5)

  B)      Apply and draw meta model of Chain of responsibility design pattern with suitable  
  example.                                                                                 (5)

  B)          Apply State design pattern for the following scenario:  
  Consider the state of a casual door in a factory and there is a single button to operate this  
  door with below states:-  
  
  1. If closed, door begins opening  
  2. If opening, another click begins closing                                                  (5)  
  3. Once open, 2 seconds later (timeout), the door begins closing and can be  
  prevented by clicking after open state and before timeout begins  
  
  Draw UML diagram by applying the state design pattern for modelling the event flow of  
  different states such as door open, door closing, door stay open and door opening.
